goal: Stop fee-bumped wallet transactions from receiving a locktime older than the original transaction
Eliminates an on-chain fingerprint identifying Bitcoin Core and Electrum wallet fee bumps
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Code verified with local test runs (molnard)
Tested ACK after earlier bounds and stale chain issues were addressed (nervana21)
Open suggestions on modularity and preferring functional tests over unit tests (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an on-chain fingerprinting leak for fee-bumped transactions
Empirical data shows this privacy leak affects under 2% of transaction replacements
